_comment: Places for the series base map. Coordinates are decimal degrees (lat, lon), the usual modern identifications; where a site is disputed the note says so. 'stories' are the site's story slugs that happen there. Everything drawn from this file is also described in words by make_map.py, so a blind listener gets the same map.

jerusalem.name: Jerusalem
jerusalem.note: The Pool of Siloam is at the south end of the city; the Temple Mount at its east.

jericho.name: Jericho
jericho.note: Herod's Jericho stood a little south-west of the old mound; the two are drawn as one.

bethany.name: Bethany
bethany.note: On the Jerusalem side of the Mount of Olives, the last stop on the road up from Jericho.

capernaum.name: Capernaum
capernaum.note: Jesus's base in Galilee; Edersheim's placing of the two blind men, not certain.

bethsaida.name: Bethsaida
bethsaida.note: Which ruin is Bethsaida is still argued; et-Tell is drawn, el-Araj lies 2 km south on the shore.

nazareth.name: Nazareth
nazareth.note: Where Jesus read Isaiah 61, 'recovery of sight to the blind'.

mountain_decapolis.name: The mountain by the lake
mountain_decapolis.note: Edersheim's placing, on the eastern shore in the Decapolis; Matthew gives only the Sea of Galilee and a mountain.

machaerus.name: Machaerus
machaerus.note: Herod's fortress east of the Dead Sea, where John the Baptist was held and killed, by Josephus.

shiloh.name: Shiloh
shiloh.note: Eli at the tabernacle; Ahijah's house, where Jeroboam's wife came in disguise.

gaza.name: Gaza
gaza.note: Where Samson, blinded, ground grain and pulled down the temple of Dagon.

beersheba.name: Beersheba
beersheba.note: Isaac's country; the blessing was given from his tent, place not named in Genesis 27.

samaria.name: Samaria
samaria.note: Where Elisha led the blinded Syrian army and had their eyes opened.

dothan.name: Dothan
dothan.note: Where the Syrians were struck blind and the servant's eyes were opened to the hills full of horses and chariots.

damascus.name: Damascus
damascus.note: Saul, blinded on the road, was led in by the hand; Straight Street is still there.

caesarea_philippi.name: Caesarea Philippi
caesarea_philippi.note: Just after Bethsaida in Mark, where Peter said 'You are the Christ'.

shechem.name: Shechem
shechem.note: Between Mount Gerizim to the south and Mount Ebal to the north, where the tribes stood to answer the blessings and curses (Deuteronomy 27).

off_map.name: Babylon and Riblah
off_map.note: Zedekiah was blinded at Riblah in Syria and taken to Babylon; both lie beyond this map.

off_map.name: Egypt
off_map.note: Jacob blessed Joseph's sons in Egypt, beyond this map.

off_map.name: Nineveh and Ecbatana
off_map.note: Tobit's story, if included, lies in Assyria and Media, beyond this map.

off_map.name: Mount Sinai
off_map.note: Where the Law was given, about eleven days' walk south of Jerusalem by the traditional site; beyond this map.
